BillHeading.BriefDescription: Preventing the curtailment of employment opportunities by allowing employers to pay a training wage for a specified period of time.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to preventing the curtailment of employment opportunities by allowing employers to pay a training wage for a specified period of time; and adding a new section to chapter 49.46 RCW.

BillSection.BillSectionHeader: Sec. 1. A new section is added to chapter 49.46 RCW to read as follows:
BillSection.P: The director shall establish procedures for the issuance of special training certificates to employers to pay new employees wages at a rate of ten dollars and fifty cents per hour, or the minimum wage rate required under federal law, whichever is greater, during a training period. The following restrictions apply to the use of the training certificates:
(1) Only employee positions paid on an hourly basis are eligible for the special training certificate;
(2) The training period may not exceed the first one hundred days of employment; and
(3) Employers may only use the special training certificate once per employee.
